messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Embroider wants a quick preflight for their model variant 'scarlet-q4b'. AE called for hosted demo + short dedicated burst for the customer POC. They want latency ~<150ms p50 at 512 tokens and VPC-only ingress.
Priya: got it. Can we get their expected peak RPS and context sizes? Q4 variants have different perf curves.
Alex: Peak demo RPS ~55, steady ~15. Typical prompt lengths 80-900 tokens, and a few sessions with ~3500 token context. They plan to reuse chat prefixes heavily.
Omar: If they're doing 3.5k contexts we must ensure KV sharding or multi-GPU span. On A100-80 two-GPU shard should work, but q4b may need mem tuning. Also check driver/kernel compatibility.
Lina: Ops checklist:
```
- confirm model artifact & license
- validate quant kernels on test infra (kernels v2.1)
- reserve ded-burst-2gpu for 3hrs (warmup + perf)
- enable SHARD_KV=true, KV_EVICT_POLICY=LRU
- tracing tag: scarlet-poc-embroider
```
Lina: I'll reserve the ded-burst-2gpu slot for Tuesday 09:00-12:00 PT and turn on full GPU mem/tracing.
Priya: Perf plan: baseline n=30 @1 RPS, ramp to 60 RPS, seq lenses [128,512,1024,3500], record p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and KV hit rate. We'll run hosted then dedicated.
Alex: Sales ask: estimate hosted vs dedicated per-token delta and a 30-day dedicated promo quote. Can we get rough numbers now?
Priya: ballpark: q4b compute ~0.55x fp16 per-token compute cost. If they switch to fp16 for production expect ~1.7x compute cost vs q4b. Dedicated pricing depends on commitment; for a 30-day POC price I can propose a promotional 25% discount on reserved A100-80 list — Omar can confirm infra cost.
Omar: confirmable. For two A100-80s: list x per-hour -> I'll do a quick calc and DM for the quote to preserve margin.
legal-bot: Reminder: please attach the model license and the customer SSQ. Legal will need to review redistribution / weight storage terms.
Alex: uploaded docs: https://files.redwood/embroider/scarlet-q4b-license.pdf and SSQ at https://files.redwood/embroider/embroider-ssq.pdf
legal-bot: Noted. Quick checklist for SSQ: data usage, retention policy, no-derivative clause, key management (KMS), and on-prem options. We'll draft language for the POC addendum: no derivative training on customer data + data isolation guarantees.
Priya: ops note: to hit <150ms p50 at 512 we should disable continuous batching during demo and pin traffic to low-latency nodes. Add env overrides: `BATCHING_STRATEGY=manual; CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false; NODE_TAG=lowlat`
Lina: deploy-bot: template `ded-burst-2gpu` exists. Command: `rb deploy start --template ded-burst-2gpu --env embroider-POC --model scarlet-q4b --tags scarlet-poc-embroider`
deploy-bot: ACK. Template validated. Reservation window set as requested.
Alex: Client also asked: do we log raw inputs? They want assurances. Marco/legal expects default is to not retain raw inputs for POCs unless explicitly enabled; we can offer redact-on-ingest.
Omar: Ops addendum: set `LOG_RAW_INPUTS=false` and document retention TTL in the onboarding playbook.
Priya: I'll prepare a short AE demo playbook with warmup commands, payload examples, failure rollback steps, and a cost matrix for q4b vs fp16. Will post here when ready.
Alex: thanks. Any immediate blockers?
Lina: only one: need to validate the q4b quant kernels on kernel v2.1 with our infra image. I'll run a quick compat test tonight and upload results.
legal-bot: I'll loop Legal for the POC addendum. Expect draft in 48 hours.
Alex: perfect. tagging @AE to schedule demo once perf & legal are green. :thumbsup:
